title: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
full_text: Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201649 Act Number: 49 Enactment Date: 2016-12-27 Act Year: 2016 Short Title: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. Long Title: An Act to give effect to the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of WOMAN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT Enforcement Date: 19-04-2017 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 19th April, 2017 vide notification no. S.O. 1215 (E) dated 19th April, 2017 see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3 (ii). Ref Act ID: 201649 Schedule 1.
